changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `diagnostic_event_log` ( `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT 'primary key', `event_id` varchar(64) NOT NULL COMMENT 'event unique id', `trace_id` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'publish trace id', `event_time` datetime NOT NULL COMMENT 'event time', `event_type` varchar(64) NOT NULL COMMENT 'event type', `event_level` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'info' COMMENT 'info/warn/error', `stage` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'client/publish_gateway/terminal_gateway/content/alarm/operation', `service_name` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'source service', `chain_id` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'chain id', `chain_code` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'chain code', `content_id` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'content id', `source_ip` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'publish client ip', `source_port` int(11) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'publish client port', `board_ip` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'board ip', `board_port` int(11) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'board port', `operator_id` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'operator id', `operator_name` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'operator name', `client_ip` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'operator client ip', `ukey_id` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'ukey id', `cert_serial_no` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'certificate serial no', `cert_name` varchar(200) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'certificate name', `sign_status` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'sign status', `verify_status` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'verify status', `result_status` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'success/fail', `summary` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'diagnostic summary', `error_code` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'error code', `error_message` varchar(1000) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'error message', `ref_table` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'reference table', `ref_id` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'reference id', `detail_json` text COMMENT 'detail json', `dedup_key` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'dedup key', `repeat_count` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1' COMMENT 'repeat count', `last_repeat_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'last repeat time', `create_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT 'create time', `update_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT 'update time', PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `uk_event_id` (`event_id`), KEY `idx_event_time` (`event_time`), KEY `idx_trace_id` (`trace_id`), KEY `idx_chain_time` (`chain_id`,`event_time`), KEY `idx_content_id` (`content_id`), KEY `idx_source_time` (`source_ip`,`event_time`), KEY `idx_board_time` (`board_ip`,`event_time`), KEY `idx_operator_time` (`operator_id`,`operator_name`,`event_time`), KEY `idx_event_type_time` (`event_type`,`event_time`), KEY `idx_cert_serial_no` (`cert_serial_no`), KEY `idx_dedup_key` (`dedup_key`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='diagnostic event log';
